skills.name: negative-prompt-leakage
skills.description: When writing FORBIDDEN/NEVER/✗ example blocks in an LLM prompt, never spell out the literal forbidden phrase — models pattern-match into the bad example and reproduce it; use a short abstract marker instead.
skills.useFor: Prompts where the model keeps producing an output you explicitly told it never to produce.

skills.name: fail-closed-guards
skills.description: When a guard/gate/precondition depends on data that might be missing, make the missing-data fallback REFUSE the action, not allow it — and confirm every write-site actually populates the field the guard reads.
skills.useFor: Writing or reviewing any permission check, gate, or precondition with a fallback default.

skills.name: twilio-a2p-10dlc-compliance
skills.description: Get a Twilio 10DLC A2P SMS campaign approved, or un-stick a rejected one — decodes the common rejection codes and covers the non-obvious resubmission mechanics.
skills.useFor: A FAILED/rejected Twilio A2P campaign, or building an SMS opt-in flow before submitting one.

skills.name: skill-estate-guardian
skills.description: Continuously lint your own AI-agent tooling (skills, subagent definitions, workflow scripts, hooks) for the defect classes that quietly rot an agent estate — leaked tokens, retired model IDs, unpinned models, gate docs with no real enforcement.
skills.useFor: A pre-flight check after writing/editing a skill or agent, or a periodic cleanup pass over your whole skills directory.

skills.name: roast-me
skills.description: Multi-round adversarial questioning that forces you to defend a design BEFORE you build it — generates hard questions across failure modes, edge cases, security, and performance, then iterates on your answers.
skills.useFor: Stress-testing a plan or architecture decision before you commit to building it.

skills.name: ai-tells-check
skills.description: A pre-flight linter for the highest-signal 'AI-slop' tells in generated frontend/marketing copy — em-dashes, numbered eyebrows, BETA labels, generic filler phrases, decorative status dots.
skills.useFor: A fast last check after generating any landing page, hero section, or marketing UI.

skills.name: data-illustration
skills.description: Turn a set of scores/metrics into an accurate AND illustrative graphic — the data literally drives the shape of the artwork, so it reads as a designed illustration instead of a generic chart.
skills.useFor: Visualizing scores/metrics/dimensions when a plain bar/line/pie chart would be boring or off-brand.

skills.name: agent-engineering-checklist
skills.description: A curated checklist of ~18 evidence-grounded rules for building reliable AI agents — tool-use gating, verification-before-trust, context engineering, and safety/trust boundaries.
skills.useFor: Designing a new agent/workflow, or reviewing an existing one for reliability gaps before more autonomous use.

skills.name: agent-quality-loop
skills.description: Iteratively grade and improve a conversational AI agent's prompt quality without real end-users — synthetic dialogs, hard checks + an LLM judge, targeted human-approved prompt edits until quality plateaus.
skills.useFor: After any meaningful change to a conversational agent's system prompt, or as a regression gate before a demo/release.

skills.name: ai-ugc-video-pipeline
skills.description: A hardened, gated pipeline for producing short-form AI-generated 'UGC-style' marketing video — hard-won fixes for the media-validation, audio-sync, and judge-hallucination traps that silently ship broken output.
skills.useFor: Producing or re-cutting a short-form AI-presenter product/marketing video.

skills.name: expert-fanout
skills.description: Spawn N domain-expert subagents in parallel to audit a codebase, product, or design from different angles, then synthesize convergent vs. divergent recommendations.
skills.useFor: Breaking out of a surgical-patch loop, getting a second opinion before a risky change, comparing two architecture options.

skills.name: doc-iterate
skills.description: Process inline review-comment markers left in shared Markdown docs, apply edits in place, preserve history, and flag contradictions instead of guessing.
skills.useFor: Async doc review between collaborators without a full comment/suggestion system.

skills.name: bug-replay
skills.description: Turn every fixed bug into a permanent regression fixture and replay the whole set before you ship anything.
skills.useFor: Catching regressions on bugs you already fixed, building a growing regression suite from real incidents.

skills.name: ship-as-artifact
skills.description: Render any finished deliverable (report, brief, plan, design, mockup) as a self-contained hosted page and hand over the link instead of a terminal dump.
skills.useFor: Reports, briefs, audits, roadmaps, and design/mockup previews meant to be read, reviewed, or shared.

skills.name: offload
skills.description: Route self-contained work off your primary AI assistant's metered quota onto a secondary backend you already have, then verify the result yourself.
skills.useFor: Being low on quota, parallelizing independent work, or getting an independent second opinion.

skills.name: quality-gate-registry
skills.description: Map every 'done' claim to the specific proof required before you say it out loud.
skills.useFor: Preventing confidently reporting unverified tests, builds, deploys, or fixes as complete.

skills.name: staff-code-review
skills.description: A maximum-depth, multi-agent code review that auto-locates the diff, fans out a cross-functional panel, adversarially verifies findings, and synthesizes a prioritized risk register.
skills.useFor: Pre-merge high-stakes diffs and production-readiness audits.

skills.name: production-gauntlet
skills.description: A looped, dual-verification stress-test and KPI gate to run before calling any non-trivial change 'done'.
skills.useFor: Wanting genuine walk-away quality on anything non-trivial you've built, fixed, or deployed.

skills.name: autobuild-loop
skills.description: An end-to-end, self-verifying build pipeline (plan, swarm, docs, QA, code quality, canary, summary) gated stage-by-stage on verification artifacts.
skills.useFor: A defined-end-state build you want to walk away from and trust came back correct.

skills.name: skill-miner
skills.description: Mine your own AI-assistant session transcripts for repeated workflow patterns and draft candidate reusable skills, queued for human approval.
skills.useFor: Discovering which of your repeated multi-step workflows would make good reusable skills.
